checks: Deriver (hand) and checker (machine) agree per topology (all 12 graphs, both chiralities) and in total after mapping the checker's labels (Bbar_i = L, B_i = R; checker's fg^(y1 b y) in Bbar2/B2 is -deriver's fg^(e b e')).

Referee re-derived the constants (1, i, -i for e, f, g L; 1, -i, i for R), the reductions khat^2 kbar^2 -> -eta/3, khat^2 k^2 -> -eta/2, khat^2 kbar-slash k^mu -> -eta/12 gbar^mu, and the vanishing of (a)-(d) by hand; re-ran check_explicit_matrices.py (all topologies agree, d = 4..12) and check_cffv_total.py; independent numpy check of all group sums for SU(3), SU(2) (referee_group_check.py).

Pole: N0 = 0 graph by graph; b_d delta S^(1) restricted to omega Psibar Psi A vanishes (b_d Q_rho[fg] and b_d Q_R^(fr) cancel, source-free counterterms give nothing at q = 0), as required by the pole check of sec:m-oneloop.

Enumeration: 220 labelled multiplet-level graphs over the 27 assignments of ENUMERATION.md (17 for omega_G Qbar Q G: 7 + 4 + 6); 10 further assignments with identically vanishing group factors (found by the checker) are 0.

Literature: agrees with BIMS 2004.14398 eq. (6.25b), (C_ad/4) int f^(abc) c_a psibar G-slash^b T^c psi (with BIMS's prefactor -i hbar times i = hbar), including the sign and the statements that only the four graphs f, g contribute and e cancels; also consistent with the targets' Delta S_ST term -(1/4) sum_f [Rbar s_C Psi - (s_C Psibar) R] = -(C_ad/4) Q_R through b Q_R superset i(N_FV - N_VF).
caveats: targets_in_our_conventions.md, g1_cFFV line, has the opposite sign (X superset (l/4) Psibar i[A-slash, omega_C] P Psi = -(our X)); diagnosed as a Grassmann reordering slip in the translation (moving c_a past psibar), since BIMS (6.25b) and the target file's own Delta S_ST both give our sign.

Under (N1)-(N4) this class requires Delta S^(1) superset -(1/16pi^2) C_ad^((r))/4 sum_f Q_R^(fr) (r = G, W) and predicts X_ccRF superset +(1/16pi^2) C_ad^((r))/4 (N_RR^(frr) + Nbar_RR^(frr)); to be confirmed by g1_ccRF and the final solution.
Graphs (a)-(d) vanish only in their degree-0 local part (integrand zero at q = 0); they are non-zero at q != 0 but contribute nothing to N0 or N1.
